content_blocks.text: RAG Attack Techniques: Information Leakage and Poisoning: this one matters because security teams lose time when the basics are fuzzy. Keep it practical.
What RAG Attack Techniques: Information Leakage and Poisoning is, where it fits in ai_security, and the problems it solves.

Hands-on drill: inspect a sample environment, identify 3 weak spots, and write the smallest safe fix.
Real-world use: how this shows up during investigations, hardening, or incident response.

Don’t memorize fluff. Learn the pattern, then apply it under pressure.
